notes.title: Horizon's Mirage - Version 1.0
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, great news: Horizon's Mirage just hit version 1.0 and its ready to release! It's been quite an exciting journey, filled with long nights, hard work and commitment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579378/cf5f28b5da03b24973aec0dd79308a146166d491.png

About the game 
Horizon's Mirage is an atmospheric first-person platformer set in a deserted cityscape where all kinds of anomalies and dangers await. Explore and search for ability points to unlock powers like slow motion, jetpack, air dash and more.

Gameplay
You are trapped in a deserted cityscape, filled with all kinds of anomalies and dangers, thus have to reach the holographic statue to escape, which is at the other side of the city.
Game paced:

 Game pacing
Play slow or fast. There is no timer or other thing that rushes you. Reach the checkpoints and try not to fall or get hit by some hazard.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579378/11d0825e7b49aa1bdc8d304a03f7862ff8668774.png
 Unlock ability powers
After a few collected points you can start unlocking powers through the ability panels. There are no limits on how much powers the player can use. Total of 5 ability powers: Slide, Double Jump, Air Dash, Time Reduction (slow motion), Elevation (Jetpack). Each ability costs different amount of points.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579378/735b5cc97827ae67b2a560f299fc9b42a29b8643.png

Release date
The game is set to launch November 4, 2024
Even though the game is finished, it will continue to receive updates for improvements, bug fixes, etc. after the release.

Recent updates

 Added camera bobbing (shake) for the idle, walk and sprint state for the character.
 Added skin color customization for the character.
 Added UI for the ability powers with cooldown.

 Improved visuals.
 Improved VRAM usage.
 Improved ladder climbing.

 Implemented achievements.
 Added support for 8 languages.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2579510/Horizons_Mirage/

notes.title: Horizon's Mirage - Development Update: Patch Version 0.9.1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579378/cefecbd857e4aa1d695fe7742fd9db938d126f1d.png

Hey everyone, hope you are doing well, patch version 0.9.1 is here with a bunch of new features and improvements.

Patch notes:

 Character customization
 Added mountains as a landscape around the city
 Added "continue" / "new game" buttons in the main menu.
 Improved visual effects
 Game optimizations


Character customization

You can now change the emission color of the player's skin in the General settings. From blue-green-red-white to dark (off)


Added mountains as a landscape around the city

Now there are mountains and ridges all around the city.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579378/153ddbb15076b9ac6f98691a47a6860c1c88aa7c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579378/3dac403e64ca84b63e5cd9e45bd48d2acc16e8d1.png


Added "continue" / "new game" buttons in the main menu.

Now there are two new buttons in the main menu. If no save file exist only the "new game" button will work, if there is, "continue" will take you to the last checkpoint you have reached. "New game" button will pop out a warning that the save will be deleted to start a new game.


Improved visual effects

New post processing effects, improved visual effects and lighting.


Horizon's Mirage is getting closer to release, make sure to Wishlist and follow to be notified of future news and updates

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2579510/Horizons_Mirage/

notes.title: Development Update & Future News
notes.notes:
Hello future urban adventures!

Here are all the recent features and improvements added in the game, plus future plans.
[previewyoutube=L4h08EDKQtg;full][/previewyoutube]
Slope Sliding Mechanic
If the surface is too incline the player starts sliding, while increasing speed and momentum.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579378/64c66964b3ee5757f1a2a27cd7f9321119704d7e.gif

Adding New Obstructions
Bringing all kinds of dangers and obstacles to overcome.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579378/8b97898e5f8101bba19623409cd4172e788b9b2a.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579378/7664d0dee51ddd59640e18ef62fa0f209c1d93df.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579378/da7c050a55ba525f4ce1c7e0be41cdc3ffafa981.gif

Interaction System
The interact preview text now shows the current mapped key.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579378/4fc8f8079982beebda948f367f548c4527841c30.gif

Polished Time Reduction Ability
While the global time is slowed by 80 percent the player's perception is now only 30 percent,
which means the movement and momentum is almost not affected. The sound of the
surroundings is also affected.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579378/299cd0d7a933eb2ac4219014e602a8207ad5e52b.gif

Future Plans
More ability skills
More areas to explore
Multiple paths to progress
A teleporter to areas that are unreachable otherwise

The game is planned to release Q3 2024 for PC Windows
